slides.text:
How to tell if your battery is really dying
Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health

Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health
Under 85% means meaningful capacity is gone
Watch which app sits at 40%+ in battery usage
A rogue location app drains more than screen
Restart weekly to clear silent background hogs

posts.title: Find your MacBook battery drainer

slides.text:
Find your MacBook battery drainer
Open Activity Monitor (Spotlight > 'Activity Monitor')
Sort by CPU, then by Energy
Close the browser tab silently maxing cores
Check background apps under the Energy tab
Dim the screen — the display uses the most.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Find your MacBook battery drainer 🍎

1. Open Activity Monitor (Spotlight > 'Activity Monitor')
2. Sort by CPU, then by Energy
3. Close the browser tab silently maxing cores
4. Check background apps under the Energy tab
5. Dim the screen
     ✓ the display uses the most.
